We do not stay at home during the holiday. We take a trip to the seaside.
What does “take a trip” mean here?

People think this animal is a fish. In fact, it is a whale.

questions.explanation: Here, “in fact” means “used to introduce what is really true”.

questions.explanation: Here, “on foot” means “by walking”.

translation.stem: 洗完杯子后，我的双手湿了。

questions.stem: The water is d________.
questions.hint: a long way from top to bottom
questions.explanation: "Deep" describes the water. Remember the two letters e in "deep".

translation.stem: 水很深。

questions.stem: Lily often h________ in the park with her parents on Sundays.
questions.hint: eat meals outdoors for pleasure, often taking the food with you
questions.grammar: 一般现在时 第三人称单数 have变has
questions.explanation: "Often" and "on Sundays" show a habit. With "Lily", use "has", not "have". Both "has picnics" and "has a picnic" are natural here.
questions.parentExplanation: often 与 on Sundays 表示习惯。主语 Lily 是第三人称单数，have 改为 has。填 has picnics；has a picnic 也自然、正确。

translation.stem: 莉莉星期日经常和父母在公园野餐。

questions.stem: Every summer, Maya t________ with her parents to a new city.
questions.hint: travels somewhere for a visit or holiday
questions.explanation: Maya is one person, so take becomes takes.
questions.parentExplanation: Maya为第三人称单数，take变为takes。

translation.stem: 每年夏天，玛雅和父母去一个新城市旅行。

questions.stem: Mia thinks Tom is at school. I________, he is at home.
questions.hint: used to tell the truth about a situation
questions.explanation: In fact introduces the real situation: Tom is at home.
questions.parentExplanation: in fact引出真实情况，即汤姆在家。

translation.stem: 米娅以为汤姆在学校。事实上，他在家。

questions.stem: I g________ at ten, but I sometimes read in bed before I fall asleep.
questions.hint: Use the three-word phrase for getting into bed to sleep, even if sleep comes later.
questions.explanation: Getting into bed to sleep is going to bed, not necessarily falling asleep immediately.
questions.parentExplanation: 先上床、之后才睡着，考go to bed，不是立刻睡着。

translation.stem: 我十点上床，但有时会在床上读书，之后才睡着。

questions.stem: Getting dressed, eating breakfast and going to school are parts of our d________.
questions.hint: Use the two-word phrase for ordinary activities in everyday living.
questions.explanation: These are ordinary things we do every day, forming daily life.
questions.parentExplanation: 每天常做的事情属于daily life。our daily lives强调各人的日常生活，同样自然。

translation.stem: 穿衣、吃早饭和上学是我们日常生活的一部分。

passages.text: Our class uses the school garden on Friday afternoon. Before we go outside, Mia goes to the office to pick up the key that our teacher left there. We open the garden gate and see cups and paper on the ground. Everyone helps to clean up the garden before the younger children arrive. Ben puts the cups in a box, and I put the paper in a bin. Soon the garden is clean again, and we can all enjoy reading outside together.

parallelText.en: Our class uses the school garden on Friday afternoon.
parallelText.zh: 周五下午我们班使用学校花园。

parallelText.en: Before we go outside, Mia goes to the office to pick up the key that our teacher left there.
parallelText.zh: 出去前，米娅去办公室领取老师留在那里的钥匙。

parallelText.en: We open the garden gate and see cups and paper on the ground.
parallelText.zh: 我们打开花园的门，看见地上有杯子和纸。

parallelText.en: Everyone helps to clean up the garden before the younger children arrive.
parallelText.zh: 在低年级孩子到来前，大家帮忙把花园打扫干净。

parallelText.en: Ben puts the cups in a box, and I put the paper in a bin.
parallelText.zh: 本把杯子放进盒子，我把纸放进垃圾桶。

parallelText.en: Soon the garden is clean again, and we can all enjoy reading outside together.
parallelText.zh: 不久，花园又干净了，大家可以一起享受户外阅读。

wordHelp.meaning: a door in a wall or fence

passages.text: Our class wants to put on a short play for the other pupils. We choose a story about two friends who help each other. On Thursday, we get the hall ready for the show by moving the chairs into rows. Mia checks the pictures, while Ben makes sure that everyone can hear the music. I stand by the door and show the younger pupils where to sit. Everyone helps with a job, so we feel happy when the show begins.

parallelText.en: Our class wants to put on a short play for the other pupils.
parallelText.zh: 我们班想为其他学生上演一部短剧。

parallelText.en: We choose a story about two friends who help each other.
parallelText.zh: 我们选了一个讲述两位朋友相互帮助的故事。

parallelText.en: On Thursday, we get the hall ready for the show by moving the chairs into rows.
parallelText.zh: 周四，我们把椅子排成行，为演出准备好大厅。

parallelText.en: Mia checks the pictures, while Ben makes sure that everyone can hear the music.
parallelText.zh: 米娅检查图片，本则确保大家能听见音乐。

parallelText.en: I stand by the door and show the younger pupils where to sit.
parallelText.zh: 我站在门边，告诉低年级学生坐在哪里。

parallelText.en: Everyone helps with a job, so we feel happy when the show begins.
parallelText.zh: 每个人都承担了一项工作，所以演出开始时，我们很高兴。

wordHelp.meaning: a large room for meetings or shows
